title: Peruvian Clay Pilaf
description: A flavorful and gluten-free Peruvian-inspired pilaf dish made with clay pot-cooked rice and crisp vegetables.
instructions: Preheat the clay pot in the oven at 400°F (200°C) for 10 minutes.
Rinse the Peruvian rice and drain well.
Add the rice to the preheated clay pot and stir well.
Add 2 cups of water to the clay pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and cover the clay pot with a lid.
Simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the water is absorbed and the rice is cooked.
Add the cooked vegetables and crisp vegetables to the clay pot and stir well.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
